name: How long does garage conversion permitting take?

mainEntity.name: How long does garage conversion permitting take?

acceptedAnswer.text: 30-90 days typical; streamlined ADU conversions often get 60-day approval; complex structural work or non-compliant existing conditions extend timelines.
